question.en: For values where sin x≠0, which expression is equal to (1−cos²x)/sin x?
question.ru: Для значений, где sin x≠0, какое выражение равно (1−cos²x)/sin x?
question.uz: sin x≠0 bo‘lgan qiymatlarda (1−cos²x)/sin x qaysi ifodaga teng?

explanation.en: Since 1−cos²x=sin²x, the expression becomes sin²x/sin x=sin x for sin x≠0.
explanation.ru: Так как 1−cos²x=sin²x, выражение становится sin²x/sin x=sin x при sin x≠0.
explanation.uz: 1−cos²x=sin²x, demak ifoda sin²x/sin x=sin x, sin x≠0 bo‘lganda.

questions.source_ref: Complete Pure Mathematics 1, 2nd ed., Ch5 Trigonometry, printed pp. 86–104

question.en: Where tan x is defined, which expression is identically equal to tan x cos x?
question.ru: Там, где tan x определён, какое выражение тождественно равно tan x cos x?
question.uz: tan x aniqlangan joylarda tan x cos x qaysi ifodaga aynan teng?

explanation.en: tan x=sin x/cos x. Therefore tan x cos x=(sin x/cos x)cos x=sin x.
explanation.ru: tan x=sin x/cos x. Поэтому tan x cos x=(sin x/cos x)cos x=sin x.
explanation.uz: tan x=sin x/cos x. Shuning uchun tan x cos x=(sin x/cos x)cos x=sin x.

questions.source_ref: Complete Pure Mathematics 1, 2nd ed., Ch5 Trigonometry, printed pp. 86–104

explanation.en: sin²x+cos²x=1, so the numerator is 1. The expression is therefore 1/cos²x.
explanation.ru: sin²x+cos²x=1, поэтому числитель равен 1. Значит выражение равно 1/cos²x.
explanation.uz: sin²x+cos²x=1, demak surat 1. Shuning uchun ifoda 1/cos²x.

questions.source_ref: Complete Pure Mathematics 1, 2nd ed., Ch5 Trigonometry, printed pp. 86–104

question.en: For sin x≠0, simplify [(1−cos x)(1+cos x)]/sin²x.
question.ru: При sin x≠0 упростите [(1−cos x)(1+cos x)]/sin²x.
question.uz: sin x≠0 bo‘lganda [(1−cos x)(1+cos x)]/sin²x ni soddalashtiring.

explanation.en: (1−cos x)(1+cos x)=1−cos²x=sin²x. Dividing by sin²x gives 1.
explanation.ru: (1−cos x)(1+cos x)=1−cos²x=sin²x. Деление на sin²x даёт 1.

question.en: Which simplification is NOT algebraically valid in general?
question.ru: Какое упрощение в общем случае НЕ является алгебраически корректным?
question.uz: Qaysi soddalashtirish umumiy holda algebraik jihatdan TO‘G‘RI EMAS?

text.en: (sin x cos x)/cos x = sin x, if cos x≠0
text.ru: (sin x cos x)/cos x = sin x, если cos x≠0
text.uz: (sin x cos x)/cos x = sin x, agar cos x≠0

text.en: (1+sin x)/sin x = 1+1/sin x, if sin x≠0
text.ru: (1+sin x)/sin x = 1+1/sin x, если sin x≠0
text.uz: (1+sin x)/sin x = 1+1/sin x, agar sin x≠0

explanation.en: You cannot cancel sin x across the addition 1+sin x. In fact (1+sin x)/sin x=1/sin x+1, when sin x≠0.
explanation.ru: Нельзя сокращать sin x через сумму 1+sin x. На самом деле (1+sin x)/sin x=1/sin x+1 при sin x≠0.
explanation.uz: 1+sin x yig‘indisi ichida sin x ni qisqartirib bo‘lmaydi. Aslida sin x≠0 bo‘lsa, (1+sin x)/sin x=1/sin x+1.

question.en: Where tan x is defined, which expression is equal to tan x cos²x?
question.ru: Там, где tan x определён, какое выражение равно tan x cos²x?
question.uz: tan x aniqlangan joylarda tan x cos²x qaysi ifodaga teng?

explanation.en: tan x cos²x=(sin x/cos x)cos²x=sin x cos x.
explanation.ru: tan x cos²x=(sin x/cos x)cos²x=sin x cos x.
explanation.uz: tan x cos²x=(sin x/cos x)cos²x=sin x cos x.

questions.source_ref: Complete Pure Mathematics 1, 2nd ed., Ch5 Trigonometry, printed pp. 86–104

question.uz: 1+cos x≠0 bo‘lganda sin²x/(1+cos x) ni soddalashtiring.

explanation.en: sin²x=1−cos²x=(1−cos x)(1+cos x). Cancel the common factor 1+cos x to get 1−cos x.
explanation.ru: sin²x=1−cos²x=(1−cos x)(1+cos x). Сокращаем общий множитель 1+cos x и получаем 1−cos x.
explanation.uz: sin²x=1−cos²x=(1−cos x)(1+cos x). Umumiy 1+cos x ko‘paytuvchini qisqartirib, 1−cos x ni olamiz.

question.en: Where tan x and sin x are defined and non-zero, simplify sin x/tan x.
question.ru: Там, где tan x и sin x определены и ненулевые, упростите sin x/tan x.
question.uz: tan x va sin x aniqlangan va noldan farqli joylarda sin x/tan x ni soddalashtiring.

explanation.en: sin x/tan x=sin x/(sin x/cos x)=cos x.
explanation.ru: sin x/tan x=sin x/(sin x/cos x)=cos x.
explanation.uz: sin x/tan x=sin x/(sin x/cos x)=cos x.

questions.source_ref: Complete Pure Mathematics 1, 2nd ed., Ch5 Trigonometry, printed pp. 86–104

question.en: On 0°≤x≤360°, the expression sin²x/(1−cos x) is undefined at which x-values?
question.ru: На 0°≤x≤360° при каких x выражение sin²x/(1−cos x) не определено?
question.uz: 0°≤x≤360° da sin²x/(1−cos x) ifoda qaysi x qiymatlarida aniqlanmagan?

explanation.en: The denominator is zero when 1−cos x=0, so cos x=1. On the stated interval this occurs at x=0° and x=360°.
explanation.ru: Знаменатель равен нулю, когда 1−cos x=0, то есть cos x=1. На данном интервале это x=0° и x=360°.
explanation.uz: Maxraj 1−cos x=0 bo‘lganda nol, ya’ni cos x=1. Berilgan intervalda bu x=0° va x=360°.
